"""Read-only review of the exact billing diagnostic patch and completed probes."""
import ast
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
TASK = OUT.parent.parent
SOURCE = TASK / "billing-diagnostics"
EVIDENCE = TASK / "evidence/billing-entrypoint-red-green-01"
BASE = "08dad7e815b9c3c84d3bd2393818b2030a6e0cde"


def digest(data):
    return {"bytes": len(data), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}


inputs = {}


def read(path):
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    inputs[str(path)] = digest(raw)
    return raw


def old(path):
    raw = subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", BASE + ":" + path], cwd=SOURCE)
    inputs[BASE + ":" + path] = digest(raw)
    return raw


billing = "tests/test_billing_baseline_e2e.py"
test = "tests/test_immediate_unittest.py"
helper = "tests/immediate_unittest.py"
new_billing = read(SOURCE / billing)
old_billing = old(billing)
tree = ast.parse(new_billing)
tree.body = [node for node in tree.body if not (
    isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.module == "immediate_unittest")]
runner_changes = 0
for node in ast.walk(tree):
    if (isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Attribute)
            and isinstance(node.func.value, ast.Name)
            and node.func.value.id == "unittest" and node.func.attr == "main"):
        runner_changes += sum(keyword.arg == "testRunner" for keyword in node.keywords)
        node.keywords = [keyword for keyword in node.keywords if keyword.arg != "testRunner"]
assert runner_changes == 1
assert ast.dump(tree, include_attributes=False) == ast.dump(ast.parse(old_billing), include_attributes=False)
new_test = read(SOURCE / test)
tree = ast.parse(new_test)
added = 0
for node in tree.body:
    if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef) and node.name == "DiagnosticsContracts":
        selected = [method for method in node.body if isinstance(method, ast.FunctionDef)
                    and method.name == "test_billing_script_main_entrypoint_emits_subtest_failure_before_termination"]
        added += len(selected)
        node.body = [method for method in node.body if method not in selected]
assert added == 1
assert ast.dump(tree, include_attributes=False) == ast.dump(ast.parse(old(test)), include_attributes=False)
assert read(SOURCE / helper) == old(helper)
assert read(EVIDENCE / "candidate-input-01" / billing) == new_billing
assert read(EVIDENCE / "candidate-input-01" / test) == new_test
assert read(EVIDENCE / "old-08-with-candidate-selfcheck-01" / test) == new_test
assert read(EVIDENCE / "old-08-with-candidate-selfcheck-01" / billing) == old_billing

results = {}
for name, expected in (
        ("old-08-run-01", 1),
        ("candidate-frozen-probe-01", 0),
        ("new-selfcheck-old-08-run-01", 1),
        ("new-selfcheck-candidate-run-01", 0),
        ("all-selfchecks-candidate-run-01", 0),
        ("old-08-existing-selfchecks-01", 0)):
    receipt = json.loads(read(EVIDENCE / name / "receipt.json"))
    assert receipt["exit_code"] == expected
    assert not receipt.get("outer_timeout", False)
    result = {"exit_code": receipt["exit_code"], "elapsed_seconds": receipt["elapsed_seconds"]}
    for key in ("stdout.log", "stderr.log"):
        raw = read(EVIDENCE / name / key)
        if key in receipt:
            assert digest(raw) == receipt[key]
    results[name] = result

red = read(EVIDENCE / "new-selfcheck-old-08-run-01/stderr.log").decode()
assert "Ran 1 test" in red and "FAILED (failures=1)" in red
assert "assertIn(\"Traceback (most recent call last):\", before_termination)" in red
assert "ImportError:" not in red and "SYNTHETIC_SUBTEST_NOT_REGISTERED" not in red
green = read(EVIDENCE / "all-selfchecks-candidate-run-01/stderr.log").decode()
assert "Ran 5 tests" in green and green.rstrip().endswith("OK")
for name, traces in (("old-08-run-01", False), ("candidate-frozen-probe-01", True)):
    receipt = json.loads(read(EVIDENCE / name / "receipt.json"))
    assert receipt["registered_failure_before_termination"]
    assert receipt["child_exit_code"] == -15 and receipt["child_reaped"]
    assert receipt["before_equals_after_termination"] and receipt["tool_error"] is None
    for key in ("before_contains_traceback", "before_contains_witness", "before_contains_assertion_error"):
        assert receipt[key] == traces

changed = subprocess.check_output(["git", "diff", "--name-only"], cwd=SOURCE, text=True).splitlines()
assert sorted(changed) == sorted([billing, test])
subprocess.run(["git", "diff", "--check"], cwd=SOURCE, check=True)
review = {
    "reviewer": "/root", "author": "local ZCode fresh session, supervised by /root/zcode_billing_diagnostics",
    "utc": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    "base_commit": BASE, "changed_files": changed,
    "verdict": "NO_BLOCKER_FOR_BOUNDED_TEST_DIAGNOSTIC_WIRING_AND_VERIFIED_TOOL_RED_GREEN",
    "business_ast_unchanged": True, "existing_four_tool_cases_ast_unchanged": True,
    "helper_unchanged": True, "same_new_case_on_old_and_candidate": True,
    "product_CTest_count_unchanged": 92, "new_product_tests": 0,
    "tool_results": results, "input_identities": inputs,
    "limits": ["No product execution in this review.", "Does not close billing business failures or historical sanitizer roots.",
               "No claim of coordinator approval, second-model evaluation, Windows acceptance or full local matrix success.",
               "ZCode session must finish and exact source hashes must still match before commit."]}
with (OUT / "review.json").open("x") as stream:
    json.dump(review, stream, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    stream.write("\n")
print(json.dumps({"verdict": review["verdict"], "inputs": len(inputs), "product_tests_run": 0}))
